title: Distrust in (X)AI - Measurement Artifact or Distinct Construct?
benchmark_measurement: The paper is a theoretical position paper and does not conduct any benchmark measurements, religious or otherwise. It discusses the psychological constructs of trust and distrust in AI.
findings: The paper does not analyze or discuss religion, faith, or religious groups. The word 'faith' is mentioned once as a psychological component of trust (alongside hope and confidence), not in a religious context.
